name: Serverdex
description: Search the Serverdex directory of MCP servers from any MCP client: find servers by keyword or category, read a server's details and install configs, and list categories. 34,000+ servers synced daily from the official MCP registry.
author: Serverdex

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Full-text search over the Serverdex directory of MCP servers (names, titles, descriptions). Returns compact rows: slug, name, author, description, category, GitHub stars, links. Use get_server with a slug for install configs.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'postgres', 'calendar', 'web scraping'. Omit to browse.

category.description: Restrict to one category slug (see list_categories).

sort.description: new = newest first (default), name = A-Z, stars = most GitHub stars first.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Everything Serverdex knows about one server by slug: description, category, packages (npm/PyPI/Docker), remote endpoints, GitHub facts (stars, license, last push), a README excerpt and ready-to-paste client configs for Claude Desktop / Cursor.

slug.description: The server slug from search_servers or a serverdex.io/server/<slug> URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The directory's categories with live server counts and their slugs (for search_servers' category filter).
